design_principle: Retrieve engineering knowledge primarily by engineering topic/system/flow context. Jurisdiction and source location are metadata and applicability evidence, not the primary retrieval filter.

systems.WATER_SUPPLY: Pressurized potable/domestic water systems, including public mains and building water-supply systems.
systems.SEWERAGE: Wastewater/sewer systems, including gravity sewers and sewer force mains.

flow_types.PRESSURIZED: Water flowing in a closed pressurized pipe system.
flow_types.PRESSURIZED_FORCE_MAIN: Pressurized sewer force-main flow; separate from potable water supply.

topics.PIPE_VELOCITY: Allowable/design velocity ranges or limits for a specific pressurized/gravity system.
topics.PIPE_FRICTION: Head loss, roughness coefficients, Hazen-Williams, Darcy-Weisbach and friction methodology.
topics.PIPE_SIZING: Diameter selection, minimum sizes and hydraulic sizing procedures.
topics.PIPE_MATERIAL: Pipe materials, standards, pressure classes and material suitability.
topics.DEMAND_FLOW: Demand, design flow, peak factors and flow basis.
topics.STORAGE: Tank/reservoir storage criteria and operating basis.
topics.PUMP_HEAD: Pump head, energy balance and system head requirements.
topics.PUMP_PROTECTION: Booster controls, low-pressure cutoff, relief and protection requirements.
topics.SOURCE_CAPACITY: Well/source yield, source capacity and source limitations.
topics.VALVES_AIR_MANAGEMENT: Check valves, air valves and hydraulic appurtenances.
topics.HOT_WATER_RECIRCULATION: Hot-water recirculation flow, head, controls and temperature criteria.
topics.NPSH: Net positive suction head and cavitation requirements.
topics.WATER_QUALITY_PROTECTION: Potable water protection, backflow and cross-connection control.
topics.GOVERNING_CODE: Code hierarchy, AHJ and standards-selection rules.

exclusion_rules: Do not retrieve SEWERAGE velocity/self-cleansing criteria for a WATER_SUPPLY calculation merely because the word velocity matches.
Do not retrieve DRAINAGE criteria for WATER_SUPPLY calculations.
Do not use public-water-network criteria as automatic building-plumbing criteria; retrieve them as source-specific candidates and evaluate applicability.
Jurisdiction/location identifies where a source criterion applies; it does not by itself decide the engineering topic or system classification.
